Max and Mia are worried that people and animals could be in danger after a serious weather-related hazard.

They want to know which weather-related hazards could happen in their region.

Explore Max’s and Mia's questions:

1. What kinds of weather-related hazards can occur in your area or other areas? 
2. How do weather-related hazards affect animals and people? 
3. In what ways can a helicopter be used during weather-related hazards?

Share your ideas in the Documentation tool.

Use the bricks:

Build a helicopter that could be used in a weather-damaged area.
<font size="3">Program your helicopter to lower and raise its string.</font>

Turn on the Smarthub and connect it to your device. Watch the video if you need help.

Refer to the Help panel for more guidance.

Design two solutions:

Modify the helicopter to be used in a weather-related hazard area, making sure your designs are safe, easy to use, and adapted to the situation.

Consider two different solutions for one of the following:
1. Relocate an endangered animal.
2. Drop vital materials to help people.
3. Drop water to put out a fire.

Document the two solutions you have designed and explain why one of them is better than the other.

Finalise your document:

1. Describe your different prototypes.
2. Explain why you have chosen your final solutions.
3. Organise your information.
4. Insert important text, pictures, screenshots or videos.

Share your findings:

Present the hazard that has occurred and describe your drop and rescue mission.

Design new solutions 
with Max and Mia

How can you organise a rescue mission following a weather-related hazard?

In this project, you will:
• Explore different weather-related hazards that can influence the survival of a population in your region.
• Create and program a device that can relocate people and animals in a safe, easy, and respectful way, or efficiently drop materials into an area.
• Present and document your solution and explain why your solution meets the criteria.

Design new solutions:

A helicopter might not be the best vehicle for drop and rescue missions in some cases. 

Consider the following: 
1. Design another solution that you think is better.

Document why your new solution is better than the use of a helicopter.
